sections: 9.6-9.9 font dictionaries and embedded font programs

decisions: Separate resolved resource identity, effective bindings and operator occurrences
Retain exact encoded PDF stream bytes without claiming reconstructed image containers
Retain per-construction-operator CTMs for mixed-transform paths
Expose explicit Artifact scopes and validated private stamp provenance without guessing semantic decorations
Inspect font rights only through an explicit compatible provider; do not infer substitution permission
Do not claim rendered ink/effective clip/color/visibility or expansion of pattern/glyph/soft-mask paint programs in this source profile
